system.implants: Access Jacks, Anti-Glare, Basic Mesh Inserts, Chameleon Skin, Chemical Sniffer, Cortical Stack, Cyberbrain, Enhanced Vision, Mnemonic Augmentation, Neurachem (Level 1), Radar, Radar Absorbent, Shape Adjusting, T-Ray Emitter, Weapon Mount (Internal, Articulated, Laser Pulser), Wings
system.advantages: +5 to two aptitudes of the player’s choice, Armor (4/4)
system.description:
Based on the kite morph (p. 53) popular with gatecrashers, this morph is somewhat more durable and better armored. It also includes a built-in laser as well as anti-detection measures. Its default mode is turbofan-driven rotorcraft; its light weight allows it to fly and hover, even in thin atmospheres and heavy gravities. In streamlined ionic mode, it can travel at high speeds and maneuver in hurricane-force winds. In vacuum, it can drive itself with thrust-vector nozzles. It is occasionally used for aerial reconnaissance, but is most popular with spies, thieves, and discrete bodyguards.

Notes: Small Size trait

Source: Eclipse Phase Morph Recognition Guide, p. 30.
